concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 1 - CPU-Feasible Quantized Inference Benchmarking
concerns.text: User Story 1 has functional requirements (FR-001) but no anchored success criteria. The Success Criteria section only references US-2 and US-3; there is no SC‑NNN that explicitly validates the CPU‑only inference, OOM‑graceful‑skip, or logging behavior described in the story.
